headword: {権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るう
gloss: to wield power; to exercise authority

definitions.gloss: to wield power; to exercise authority
definitions.explanation: To actively use the power or authority one holds, often with a connotation of forceful or overbearing use. Frequently has a negative nuance when describing abuse of power.

examples.japanese: {独裁者|どくさいしゃ}が{権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るう。
{上司|じょうし}が{部下|ぶか}に{権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るうのは{許|ゆる}されない。
examples.english: It is not acceptable for a boss to wield power over subordinates.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}にわたって{国|くに}の{中枢|ちゅうすう}で{権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るってきた{政治家|せいじか}が、ついに{辞任|じにん}を{表明|ひょうめい}した。
examples.english: The politician who had wielded power at the heart of the government for many years finally announced his resignation.

notes:
A set expression using {振|ふ}るう (to wield, to brandish, to exercise). {振|ふ}るう is used in Japanese to describe actively and forcefully bringing something into use — it is also seen in collocations like {腕|うで}を{振|ふ}るう (to show off one's skill) and {勇気|ゆうき}を{振|ふ}るう (to muster courage). When paired with {権力|けんりょく}, it frequently carries a negative connotation, suggesting an overbearing or oppressive use of authority.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るう: to wield power
- {絶大|ぜつだい}な{権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るう: to wield enormous power
- {弱者|じゃくしゃ}に{権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るう: to wield power over the weak
- {権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}りかざす: to brandish one's authority — stronger, more negative nuance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {権力|けんりょく}を{握|にぎ}る: to seize/hold power — emphasizes gaining and holding, not necessarily using
- {権力|けんりょく}を{行使|こうし}する: to exercise power — more neutral, formal; often legal or institutional
- {支配|しはい}する: to rule, to dominate — broader, focused on the state of control
